instruction.text: Listen closely and select the correct person.

feedback.end: A baby needs lots of care. They also sleep a lot.
A toddler is a little older than a baby. They are eager to discover the world around them.
A child is older than a toddler. Their brains are very active, so they play and learn a lot.

instruction.text: Listen closely and select the correct person.

feedback.end: A teenager is older than a child. They can do lots of things by themselves and will soon become an adult.
An elderly person is an older adult. They generally don’t work any more, and their bodies are a bit slower, but that doesn’t necessarily make them less active.
An adult can live and work by themselves. They may want to create a family with another adult.
